headline: Micron (MU) Teams Up With Liqid And Microchip On AI Memory And Storage
summary: Micron Technology and Liqid are working together on a memory centric AI platform for the U.S. Department of Energy’s Pacific Northwest National Laboratory. Micron Technology is supplying memory to support a large shared pool tailored for scientific and AI workloads. Micron Technology and Microchip Technology have shown a next generation PCIe Gen 6 storage architecture for high performance data center use. Micron Technology, traded as NasdaqGS:MU, is adding new real world projects to its AI...
